notes.title: Electrogical - 25 + 7 New Stages Added | v1.1.0 Released (2025/3/8 JST)
notes.content:
Added a total of [b]32[/b] new stages that can be played after clearing the main story.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44517504/93ed679eb739d4041b8b7c80b1907ead8f02a386.png[/img]

[h2]Added 7 Trial Stages[/h2]

Added [b]7[/b] trial stages where you can test one of the upcoming new mechanics.
We are looking forward to your feedback on the new mechanic!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44517504/54faae0ba6914efa24ff24fd7438da8912f6fc40.png[/img]

[h2]Added 25 Challenge Stages[/h2]

Added score chips that increase your score when the number is even, odd, or prime.
Added challenge stages related to this mechanic.
Also added challenge stages for the Comeback Circuit Chip.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44517504/e8ed2621fba1898966a0bcbed25608e1ac7fd1a3.png[/img]

[h2]Story Sequel in Development[/h2]

We are currently working on the second half of the story.
Look forward to new mechanics and the continuation of the story!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44517504/6be99eae3be0c44bfe40c270d31674cc85f68485.png[/img]

tags.feature: Added a total of [b]32[/b] new stages that can be played after clearing the main story.

notes.title: Electrogical - Patch Notes - v1.0.1 (2024/11/25 JST)
notes.content:
We’ve made some updates to the Early Access version:

[list]
[*] You can now zoom in and out on the map using the mouse wheel.
[*] Right-clicking a piece will return it to its default position.
[*] When the goal piece’s value doesn’t match the calculated value, the current value displayed on the goal piece will now flash. This makes it easier to compare the goal value with the calculated value.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support and feedback!

notes.title: Electrogical to Exhibit at Bitsummit Drift
notes.content:
[h1]Bitsummit Drift[/h1]

Electrogical will be exhibiting at [url=https://bitsummit.org/]Bitsummit Drift[/url]. We are thrilled to have the opportunity for many people to try our game. If you are attending the event, please come and play, and enjoy the world of Electrogical.

Period
July 19, 2024 – July 21, 2024

[h1]Event-exclusive Stickers[/h1]

We are planning to give away event-exclusive stickers to those who register on our wishlist or make a post on X.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44517504/9bd84d772e23626d2ae87e145b9db29c6e919b0f.png[/img]

[h1]Planned New Features[/h1]

In conjunction with our exhibit at Bitsummit, we plan to update the demo version with the exhibition build. The following new features are planned:

[list]
[*] Story elements
[*] Auto-answer function
[*] Chinese language support
[/list]

tags.feature: Story elements
Auto-answer function
Chinese language support

notes.title: Electrogical Store & Demo Now Available
notes.content:
[h1]Electrogical Sets Off![/h1]
We've simultaneously released Electrogical on the Steam Store along with a playable demo. It brings us great joy to offer the demo for everyone to enjoy the world of Electrogical.

[h2]Your Feedback[/h2]
By playing the demo, you can provide valuable feedback. We sincerely hope to hear your thoughts. Developer kinjo highly values feedback and wishes to progress with you all to make Electrogical an even better game.

[h2]Community Hub[/h2]
We aim to build a vibrant community hub together with all of you. We're especially interested in your innovative puzzle-solving approaches. If you achieve high scores or have intriguing solutions, please do share them. In the demo, Stage 11 is designed to showcase players' creativity.

[h2]X Accounts[/h2]
Here are the related X (Twitter) accounts:

Developer kinjo's account: [url=https://twitter.com/Yutaka_Kinjyo]kinjo[/url]
Electrogical news account: [url=https://twitter.com/electrogical]electrogical[/url]

[h2]Upcoming Plans[/h2]
We're planning to participate in gamescom 2023.
https://indiegamessummit.tokyo/event_exhibition.html

It brings us great joy to offer the demo for everyone to enjoy the world of Electrogical.
